mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope(organization_unit_id,include_descendants) AS (SELECT scope_target_id,include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id=#{actorId} AND scope_type='ORGANIZATION' AND active=TRUE UNION SELECT c.organization_unit_id,TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit c JOIN visible_scope p ON c.parent_id=p.organization_unit_id WHERE p.include_descendants=TRUE)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seal.rights_request(rights_request_id,request_code,organization_unit_id,recipient_id,consent_request_id,rights_type,request_status,received_date,due_date,detail_ciphertext,encryption_key_id,created_by,created_at,row_version) SELECT #{row.id},#{row.code},rec.organization_unit_id,rec.recipient_id,req.consent_request_id,#{row.type},#{row.status},#{row.receivedDate},#{row.dueDate},#{row.detailCiphertext},#{row.keyId},#{row.createdBy},#{row.createdAt},0 FROM seal.recipient rec JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id=rec.organization_unit_id LEFT JOIN seal.consent_request req ON req.consent_request_id=CAST(#{row.consentRequestId,jdbcType=OTHER} AS UUID) WHERE rec.recipient_id=#{row.recipientId} AND rec.organization_unit_id=#{row.organizationId} AND (CAST(#{row.consentRequestId,jdbcType=OTHER} AS UUID) IS NULL OR (req.organization_unit_id=rec.organization_unit_id AND req.recipient_id=rec.recipient_id))
mapper.select: SELECT r.rights_request_id id,r.request_code code,r.rights_type type,r.request_status status,r.received_date,r.due_date,r.created_at,r.recipient_id,snapshot.snapshot_json->>'title' template_title FROM seal.rights_request r LEFT JOIN seal.consent_request req ON req.consent_request_id=r.consent_request_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_scope scoped WHERE scoped.organization_unit_id=req.organization_unit_id) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seal.user_processing_activity_scope configured WHERE configured.admin_user_id=#{actorId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seal.user_processing_activity_scope allowed WHERE allowed.admin_user_id=#{actorId} AND allowed.processing_activity_id=req.processing_activity_id)) LEFT JOIN seal.consent_request_snapshot snapshot ON snapshot.consent_request_snapshot_id=req.snapshot_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_scope scoped WHERE scoped.organization_unit_id=r.organization_unit_id) AND r.request_status=#{status} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC,r.rights_request_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT r.* FROM seal.rights_request r JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE r.rights_request_id=#{id}

mapper.update: UPDATE seal.rights_request SET request_status=#{to},verification_channel=CASE WHEN #{to}='IDENTITY_VERIFIED' THEN #{channel} ELSE verification_channel END,verification_note_ciphertext=COALESCE(#{verificationNote,jdbcType=BINARY},verification_note_ciphertext),verification_note_key_id=COALESCE(#{verificationNoteKeyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},verification_note_key_id),identity_verified_by=CASE WHEN #{to}='IDENTITY_VERIFIED' THEN #{actor} ELSE identity_verified_by END,identity_verified_at=CASE WHEN #{to}='IDENTITY_VERIFIED' THEN #{now} ELSE identity_verified_at END,decided_by=CASE WHEN #{to} IN('APPROVED','REJECTED') THEN #{actor} ELSE decided_by END,decided_at=CASE WHEN #{to} IN('APPROVED','REJECTED') THEN #{now} ELSE decided_at END,decision_code=COALESCE(#{decisionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},decision_code),result_note_ciphertext=COALESCE(#{resultNote,jdbcType=BINARY},result_note_ciphertext),result_note_key_id=COALESCE(#{resultNoteKeyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},result_note_key_id),completed_by=CASE WHEN #{to}='COMPLETED' THEN #{actor} ELSE completed_by END,completed_at=CASE WHEN #{to}='COMPLETED' THEN #{now} ELSE completed_at END,row_version=row_version+1 WHERE rights_request_id=#{id} AND request_status=#{from} AND row_version=#{version}

mapper.update: UPDATE seal.rights_request SET retention_job_id=#{jobId},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE rights_request_id=#{rightsId} AND request_status='APPROVED' AND retention_job_id IS NULL AND row_version=#{version}
